escena: SCENE (epic cinematic still, Santiago de Chile at sunrise, the moment a new customer opens her account): a Chilean professional woman in her early thirties, dark hair loose, a camel wool coat over a white shirt, stands on a high glass-railed terrace in the RIGHT half of the frame, framed from the waist up, turned three-quarters toward the LEFT, holding a smartphone at chest height with a calm, satisfied half smile, looking out over the city, never at the lens; the phone is seen from its back so its screen is never visible. Behind and below her, the city of Santiago spreads out in morning haze with the snow-capped Andes glowing gold and pink in the first sunlight. The low rising sun is the key light: a warm golden rim outlines her hair and shoulder, and the soft blue shadow side of her face is lit gently by the sky. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS, 85mm lens, camera at her eye level about two meters away, focus on her eyes, shallow depth of field. Thin haze catching the sunbeams. The LEFT 25% of the frame is only soft hazy sky and distant city, no bright sun disc. No readable text, no logos of any brand.

lecho.objeto: the dark blurred edge of the terrace's stone planter close to the lens at the bottom, outside the sunlight

texto.muro: the soft hazy sky on the left 25% of the frame
